acs.text: Registering with a unique e-mail, a rule-compliant password (sent as both password and passwordRepeat), and a security question id + security answer creates the customer: the response is HTTP 201 and its body describes the new user with the submitted email and role = customer.
outcomes: the body describes the new user with the submitted `email` (in `data`, attachments/api-contract.md#L19-L20)

acs.text: Registering with an e-mail that already belongs to a customer is rejected with HTTP 400 and a validation error whose message states the e-mail must be unique. No second account is created.
outcomes: registering an already registered e-mail → HTTP 400
a validation error whose message states the e-mail must be unique
no second account is created for that e-mail

acs.text: Registration enforces the password rules in the PO comment: a password shorter than the minimum length is rejected with HTTP 400 and the customer is not created (a follow-up login with that e-mail/password fails).
outcomes: registering with a 4-character password → HTTP 400 (minimum is 5 characters, story.md#L50, story.md#L53)
the customer is not created: a follow-up login with that e-mail/password fails

acs.text: Logging in via POST /rest/user/login with a registered customer's correct e-mail and password returns HTTP 200 and a body containing an authentication token (a JWT used as a Bearer token) and the customer's basket id (bid).
outcomes: the body contains an authentication `token` that is a JWT (`authentication.token`, attachments/api-contract.md#L33)
the body contains the customer's basket id `bid` (`authentication.bid`, attachments/api-contract.md#L33)

acs.text: Using their own token, a customer can add a product to their own basket via POST /api/BasketItems; after that customer logs in through the UI, the basket page at /#/basket lists that product with the quantity that was added.
outcomes: the customer adds a product to their own basket (`BasketId` = their `bid`) via POST /api/BasketItems with their own token
after the customer logs in through the UI, the basket page at /#/basket lists that product
the basket page shows that product with the quantity that was added

acs.text: Basket contents are private to their owner: a customer must be able to read only their own basket. A request to GET /rest/basket/{id} authenticated as customer A but targeting customer B's basket id must be refused and must not return B's basket. Verify with two customers you create.
outcomes: customer A can read their own basket via GET /rest/basket/{id} with A's basket id
GET /rest/basket/{id} authenticated as customer A with customer B's basket id is refused
that response does not return B's basket

rules.text: Each customer has exactly one basket.

The password must be at least 5 characters long (and at most 40). Anything shorter than 5 characters must be rejected at registration and the account not created; a 3- or 4-character password is a clear reject case.
The password is case-sensitive and stored hashed (not tested here beyond that a too-short password is refused).

errorModel.case: registering an e-mail that already belongs to a customer
errorModel.body: a validation error whose message states the e-mail must be unique

errorModel.case: registering with a password shorter than 5 characters
reading another customer's basket (GET /rest/basket/{id} as customer A with customer B's basket id): refused, B's basket not returned (status not stated, see G4)
